title: Bugadi Majhi Sandli Ga 🎶 | Easy Lavani Steps for Beginners | Dance With Phulwa

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down basic Lavani movements step-by-step with an upbeat and encouraging tone. She demonstrates each step clearly, often alongside back-up dancers, highlighting proper posture and common errors.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces the Lavani lesson and guest dancers.
Breaking down slide movement on the floor.

metaphors: hand move like roading a car
common_mistakes: Doing dipping on toes instead of flat feet
Bending knees incorrectly during slides and hurting knees
Knees opening too wide while sitting on the floor
safety: Never use knees for sliding on the floor as it hurts
Be careful not to open knees too wide while sitting

steps_taught.name: Dip / Dipping
steps_taught.description: Flat feet dipping movement with hands on waist.

steps_taught.name: Step ball change
steps_taught.description: Stepping forward with weight change and arm gestures.

steps_taught.name: Hop step
steps_taught.description: Hopping on one foot while tapping the other.

steps_taught.name: Slide
steps_taught.description: Sliding sideways on the floor using the side of the leg, not the knees.

what_works: Clear verbal instructions combined with visual breakdown
Demonstrating common mistakes so learners can avoid them
what_hinders: Rapid transition between steps without extensive slow drills
